German Week and Day Types: A1 Vocabulary Practice

Practise Wochentag, Wochenende, Feiertag and Arbeitstag in German schedules. Learn calendar vocabulary with translated examples and explained answers.

A1 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Vocabulary and usage

Der Wochentag (Wochentage) is a day of the week, das Wochenende (Wochenenden) the weekend, der Feiertag (Feiertage) a public or religious holiday and der Arbeitstag (Arbeitstage) a working day. Wochentag can refer to weekday names or, in some contexts, days contrasted with the weekend. Work schedules depend on the person.

Common mistake to avoid

Ein Arbeitstag is a day on which someone works in the stated context; it is not automatically every Monday or every calendar weekday.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Notice each word’s meaning, article and common word partners in context.

Worked example 1Welcher Wochentag ist der erste des Monats?Which day of the week is the first of the month?
Worked example 2Am Wochenende fahren wir zu unseren Freunden.At the weekend we visit our friends.
Worked example 3Der Feiertag fällt dieses Jahr auf einen Donnerstag.The holiday falls on a Thursday this year.
Worked example 4Mein Arbeitstag endet heute früher als sonst.My working day ends earlier than usual today.

Practice: choose the matching word

Choose the word from the bank that matches the English cue and sentence. Use each item once; keep its spelling and capitalisation. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Word bank: Arbeitstag · Feiertag · Wochenende · Wochentag

Question 1. Welcher ___ ist heute: Montag oder Dienstag? (day of the week)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: Wochentag

Wochentag names the category to which Montag and Dienstag belong.

Question 2. Samstag und Sonntag bilden hier das ___. (weekend)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: Wochenende

Wochenende is neuter and names the two-day weekend in this example.

Question 3. Ein besonderer gesetzlicher oder religiöser Festtag heißt ___. (holiday)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: Feiertag

Feiertag names the holiday without specifying a jurisdiction.

Question 4. Heute arbeitet sie acht Stunden; heute ist für sie ein ___. (working day)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: Arbeitstag

Arbeitstag refers to her work schedule in this sentence.
